entities.name: A4VLV4 Asp/Glu leucyltransferase
observations: Query sequence is an exact 235-aa match (100% identity and coverage; E=5.13e-176) to reviewed Stutzerimonas stutzeri A1501 protein A4VLV4.
UniProt annotation: transfers leucine from Leu-tRNA to N-terminal Asp/Glu residues, functioning in the N-end rule protein degradation pathway.
Annotated localization is cytoplasm; GO includes cytoplasm (GO:0005737), leucyl-tRNA--protein transferase activity (GO:0008914), and N-end rule pathway protein catabolism (GO:0071596).
Sequence Pfam hits: ATE_N PF04376, Acetyltransf_6 PF13480, ATE_C PF04377.

entities.name: N-end rule degradation
observations: Annotated role is leucylation of proteins bearing N-terminal Asp or Glu, marking them for ubiquitin-dependent degradation via the N-end rule pathway.
